name: chat-message-card
title: ChatMessageCard
description: A single chat message rendered as a card (an atom): a role Badge (user/assistant/tool/system, unknown roles fall back to a neutral outline), the text content, and any structured tool-calls / tool-results rendered via the existing CodeBlock composite (not hand-rolled). Reuses the trace-core ToolCall type so an assistant span's tool_calls drop in directly. Empty (no content, no tools) reads as an honest placeholder. Distinct from TraceTranscript (a feed) — this is one controlled message. Composes Badge/CodeBlock — zero new dependency.
